## Strategy (AI Generated by Agentic SDLC Pipeline)

### TL;DR

Generate and publish an SBOM for every shipped image at build time, attach it to the image as a signed attestation, and expose it through the product's documentation index.

### Technical Approach

#### 1. Build-time generation

The image build pipeline generates an SPDX SBOM per image and stores it next to the build record.

#### 2. Signed attestation

The SBOM is attached to the image digest as a signed attestation, verifiable with the published public key.

#### 3. Publication index

A per-release index lists every image digest with a link to its SBOM.

### Affected Components

- synth-images (build pipeline, attestation)
- release documentation index

### High Level Requirements

- HLR-1: Generate an SPDX SBOM for every shipped image at build time.
- HLR-2: Attach the SBOM to the image digest as a signed attestation.
- HLR-3: Publish a per-release index of digests and SBOM links.
- HLR-4: Fail the release gate when an image lacks a verified SBOM.

### Dependencies

- The build system must expose the final image digest to the generation step.

### Non-Functional Requirements

- No measurable latency regression on the platform's reference workloads.

### Acceptance Criteria (Proposed — requires PM/Engineering validation)

- HLR-1 is demonstrated in the release candidate.
- HLR-2 is demonstrated in the release candidate.
- HLR-3 is demonstrated in the release candidate.
- HLR-4 is demonstrated in the release candidate.

### Effort Estimate

M (one to two sprints for two teams).

### Risks

- SBOM generation adds build time; generation runs in parallel with image scanning.

### Open Questions

- None blocking.
